answer_1.quote: we hereby lay the groundwork toward gender-neutral MT... we provide the necessary tools and resources to foster research on the topic by estimating gender neutral translation in MT.

answer_2.quote: Metrics. We study the effectiveness of a set of widely used metrics. These can be categorized as i) n-gram overlap metrics: BLEU, chrF, TER, and METEOR... ii) neural model-based metrics: BERTScore, BLEURT, and COMET.

answer_4.quote: Our survey was structured into two main parts. In part (i), we indirectly assessed linguistic acceptability: given a source English sentence paired with both a gendered (GT) and a neutral (NT) translation, we asked participants to indicate whether they had a preference or found them to be equivalent.
answer_4.guideline: Participants indicated preference or equivalence between gendered/neutral translations and answered direct questions on attitudes toward gender-neutral language.
